law_name: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006

rules.name: Payment within agreed terms (max 45 days)
rules.description: Buyer must pay MSME supplier within agreed period, not exceeding 45 days from acceptance/deemed acceptance

actions.description: Flag invoice as overdue per MSMED Act Section 15
Calculate compound interest at 3x RBI bank rate

rules.legal_text: The buyer shall make payment to the micro or small enterprise supplier on or before the date agreed upon between him and the supplier in writing or, where there is no agreement in this behalf, before the appointed day.
rules.penalty_description: Compound interest at 3x bank rate from due date

rules.name: No agreement - 15 day default
rules.description: Where no written agreement exists, payment must be made within 15 days of acceptance

actions.description: Flag as overdue - no agreement, 15-day statutory default applies

rules.legal_text: Where there is no agreement regarding payment, 'appointed day' means the day following immediately after the expiry of 15 days from the day of acceptance.
rules.penalty_description: Compound interest at 3x bank rate from day 16

rules.name: Agreement exceeds 45 days - void terms
rules.description: Any agreement with payment terms exceeding 45 days is void; 45-day limit applies

actions.description: Override agreed terms to statutory 45-day maximum
Flag agreement as containing illegal payment terms

rules.legal_text: Provided that in no case the period agreed upon between the supplier and the buyer in writing shall exceed forty-five days from the day of acceptance or the day of deemed acceptance.

rules.name: MSME-1 filing required for delays > 45 days
rules.section: Section 9 read with MSME Notification dt. 02.11.2018
rules.description: Buyers with overdue MSME payments > 45 days must file MSME-1 half-yearly return
rules.legal_text: Every buyer must file a half-yearly return (Form MSME-1) with the Ministry regarding outstanding amounts owed to MSME suppliers.
